pattern.description: After the idea is submitted, the inline 'Add a quick summary' input row closes and the new 'Add dark mode' row (with placeholder skeleton cells) takes its place; the rows below shift up together while the cursor moves to the new row.
pattern.why_premium: Real product micro-interaction shown at true speed: the table reflows as one unit with no jump, and the cursor immediately directs attention to the freshly created row.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.quick-add-row', {height: 0, opacity: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}).to('.idea-row', {y: '-=45', duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<'); then tl.to('.cursor', {x: 398, y: 203, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power1.inOut'}) and set .new-row background to hover grey.
build_hint.remotion: Interpolate input-row height/opacity over ~5 frames with Easing.out(Easing.quad); translateY all following rows by -rowHeight with the same progress; move the cursor along an eased path over ~12 frames (Easing.inOut).

notes: Very short burst; the reflow appears to happen between f237 and f247 (possibly near-instant UI re-render rather than a tween). camera.move is none, so the small pan_y is the rows shifting. No SFX candidates.
